method.v_definition: h-BN internal voltage magnitude after subtracting measured-lookup transistor drop
method.gate_mapping: literal applied gate, no fitted affine gate correction or series resistance
method.transistor_preprocessing: Existing lookup: mean up/down branch, forced zero origin, cumulative maximum; up-only sensitivity repeats the analysis. Fixed-gate inverse uses exact piecewise-linear lookup segments.

branch_selection.SET: return branch after final maximum, reversed for increasing voltage

method.window_interpretation: Prespecified candidate initial low-bias windows; no independent proof that internal state is perfectly frozen. Window comparisons are sensitivity diagnostics, not optimization for agreement.

guards.interpretation: Prespecified numerical guards, not material thresholds or measurement uncertainty

method.interpolation: Linear log10(current) interpolation only on valid adjacent native segments with increasing internal voltage; folds and multiple-valued inverses excluded; no extrapolation and no interpolation across excluded points. Linear-current interpolation reported as sensitivity. Grid points are correlated, not independent measurements.
method.zero_reference_sensitivity: No offsets subtracted in main analysis. For sensitivity only, perturb each branch's current magnitude by plus/minus its own maximum absolute zero-bias readout, re-invert and re-interpolate, and report four combinations. Two-sided min/max are null unless all four combinations remain calculable. The 10-percent flag is descriptive and does not remove points or cycles. This is an illustrative processing sensitivity, not an estimated noise level, confidence interval, or calibration uncertainty.
method.fits: Identity eta=1; per-cycle best constant exp10(mean(log10 eta)); universal constant across cycles; linear trend of log10 eta versus voltage. These are descriptive same-data fits, not validation of a mechanism.
method.adequacy: No statistical rejection test without measurement error/repeat-read estimates. Residuals and a descriptive 0.1-decade benchmark are reported, not a physical acceptance threshold.
method.first_three_split: Post-hoc sensitivity motivated by the earlier v0.13 error audit. All 53 remain in the primary report; cycles 4-53 are a descriptive comparison, not a replacement dataset or independent test.

limitations: The ratio is cross-polarity and cross-scan; it does not isolate time relaxation from polarity dependence.
Numerical guards do not establish correspondence of standalone lookup devices to the target cell or quantify gate interpolation error.
0.9/1.3-V equal Sheet identifiers give exploratory pairs; only 1.1-V Si/Ri pairing is treated as confirmed.
The gate groups are not established as a controlled paired-gate experiment; do not infer a causal gate law from group medians or differently filtered subsets.
A constant eta can describe an amplitude relation without proving identical microscopic states or transport mechanisms.
Voltage-dependent eta does not uniquely distinguish contact asymmetry, transport changes, and changing state during the read branches.
